description: DIBCO TRANSFER LEARNING FROM CKPT-115 (ANRI). Mission: Fine-tune proven ckpt-115 model (33.02 dB from ANRI) for DIBCO dataset using visual-only approach. Strategy: (1) Transfer learning from ANRI fine-tuned ckpt-115, (2) Mixed dataset 70% Base + 30% DIBCO for stability, (3) Conservative hyperparameters matching ANRI success, (4) Dual validation monitoring Base PSNR for catastrophic forgetting. Expected: Break 14-15 dB ceiling → target 25-28 dB.
